purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software - inpatient patient search/inquiry subsystem (I20 screen group)
purpose.summary: This program implements the inpatient patient search screen (component I20, subsystem code ORCGI20) of the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It handles screen navigation, patient record lookup, condition-based filtering (name, age, address, birthday), and output to CSV/print via shell script ORCBI201. It is a screen-driven batch/online hybrid subprogram called via MCP linkage.

notable_features: 34 COPY statements for modular copybook includes
MCP linkage area pattern (MCPAREA, SPAAREA, LINKAREA, SCRAREA)
EVALUATE MCP-STATUS ALSO MCP-EVENT dispatch pattern
Dynamic SQL string construction (WRK-SQL PIC X(15000))
Katakana/Japanese character data in FILLER VALUE literals (EUC-JP encoding)
File output to /var/tmp/ with dynamic filename construction
REDEFINES used extensively for data overlays
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses proprietary MCP DB access layer
Age calculation and Japanese era date conversion subroutines
verdict.notes: Source is encoded in EUC-JP (decoded as latin-1), causing garbled display of Japanese comments and string literals. This is a production component of the open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. The file is 3091 lines with high comment ratio (27%) and extensive modular structure indicating mature production code. Truncated at 16000 chars but enough structure is visible for confident classification.
